title: Neurotrophin-3/chitosan inhibits cuproptosis-related genes to enable functional recovery after spinal cord injury.
authors: Wang, Siqiao; Li, Chen; Fan, Wenyong; Chen, Tao; Xu, Wei; Hu, Xiao; Wu, Zhourui; Xiao, Zhihui; Lin, Gufa; Ma, Bei; Cheng, Liming
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过RNA-seq和机器学习识别脊髓损伤中铜死亡相关基因及转录因子，并用分子对接分析壳聚糖结合，但核心是疾病治疗而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，仅边缘涉及。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study investigated the regulatory mechanisms of cuproptosis-related genes (CRGs) in spinal cord injury (SCI) and explored the therapeutic potential of neurotrophin-3 (NT3)-loaded chitosan in promoting functional recovery. METHODS: We conducted integrated bulk RNA-seq and single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) analyses of mouse spinal cord tissue at various time points after SCI. The key CRGs were identified using differential expression analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and machine learning. The therapeutic effects of NT3-loaded chitosan were evaluated using animal models and molecular docking analysis. RESULTS: We identified four key CRGs (Atp7a, Cp, Loxl2, and Pde3b) and three key transcription factors (C/EBPalpha, Stat6, and Runx1) that were upregulated post-SCI, promoting cuproptosis and neuroinflammation. NT3-loaded chitosan treatment significantly inhibited CRG expression and enhanced functional recovery in the animal models. Molecular docking analysis demonstrated binding interactions between chitosan and key CRGs, suggesting a potential mechanism for their therapeutic effects. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings highlight the critical role of CRGs in SCI progression and the potential of NT3-loaded chitosan as a therapeutic strategy for inhibiting cuproptosis and promoting functional recovery. Future studies should focus on validating these findings in larger cohorts and exploring the detailed mechanisms by which NT3-loaded chitosan modulates CRG expression.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究探讨了铜死亡相关基因（CRGs）在脊髓损伤（SCI）中的调控机制，并探索了负载神经营养因子-3（NT3）的壳聚糖在促进功能恢复中的治疗潜力。方法：我们对SCI后不同时间点的小鼠脊髓组织进行了整合的批量RNA测序和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析。通过差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析和机器学习鉴定了关键CRGs。使用动物模型和分子对接分析评估了负载NT3的壳聚糖的治疗效果。结果：我们鉴定了四个关键CRGs（Atp7a、Cp、Loxl2和Pde3b）以及三个关键转录因子（C/EBPalpha、Stat6和Runx1），它们在SCI后上调，促进铜死亡和神经炎症。负载NT3的壳聚糖治疗显著抑制了CRG表达，并增强了动物模型中的功能恢复。分子对接分析显示了壳聚糖与关键CRGs之间的结合相互作用，提示了其治疗效果的潜在机制。结论：我们的发现强调了CRGs在SCI进展中的关键作用，以及负载NT3的壳聚糖作为抑制铜死亡和促进功能恢复的治疗策略的潜力。未来研究应侧重于在更大队列中验证这些发现，并探索负载NT3的壳聚糖调节CRG表达的详细机制。
